title: In a muted channel, a mention of the viewer lights the @, does not count and does not move the row
why: RisingWave counts only the pre-mute prefix and surfaces the mention through the mention arm. Decided (Tenny, #14988 review): follow the server (RisingWave). The canonical Postgres read in getInboxItems follows it too: its count stops at the mute boundary (inboxRowMessageCountsUnreadSql), and the mention lights the @ (inboxPersonalMentionSql). It does not move a row with a pre-mute message: RisingWave keeps the row at its last message before the mute (rw_inbox_serving_v9: latest_activity_seq is the muted prefix's latest_seq; a mention-only row follows its mentions), and the Postgres read picks the row's latest message the same way (legacyChatLatestActivityMessageSql). Decided: Tenny, #triage:#244, 2026-11-16 (follow RisingWave).
